package.name: l5_seg_demo
package.description: ENPM818Z Lecture 5 hands-on, Segmentation section: semantic segmentation of the L2 bridge's front camera by a trained network (SegFormer-B0, trained on Cityscapes), graded pixel by pixel against CARLA's semantic segmentation camera mounted at the same place: IoU per class and mIoU. Optional: YOLOv8s-seg instance masks on the same image, and the network's classes for l5_bev_demo's roof cameras (semantic_bev labels:=network).
